title: Probability-Entropy Calibration: An Elastic Indicator for Adaptive Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a token-level reweighting mechanism for fine-tuning large language models to improve performance on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks. It does not evaluate or benchmark components related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics; its 'Impact Statements' section is a standard disclosure on responsible release and potential misuse.
